title: NPC/Enemy Behavior & Tiny State Machines
objective: Define original reusable MAL-local NPC/enemy behavior and tiny deterministic state-machine primitives over frozen MAL-01..04 semantics without creating autonomous canonical NPC/Character agency, hidden knowledge, Combat, World/Scene, Event, Project, progression or Permission truth.

rules: MAL-05 consumes frozen MAL-02 semantic inputs/deterministic logical ticks plus MAL-03 traversal and MAL-04 interaction projections. Raw device identity, wall-clock time, frame timing, network latency and nondeterministic randomness never become behavior truth.

NPC/enemy references are MAL-local behavior projections over authorized canonical NPC/Character references. MAL-05 never creates autonomous canonical agency, personality, goals, knowledge, allegiance, hostility, statistics, position, inventory or encounter truth.
Authored state machines are tiny, explicit and deterministic. Transition priority is authored data; the same authorized local state and logical tick produce the same next state and receipt.
Unknown, hidden or unauthorized NPC intent, awareness, target knowledge, pathing truth, Combat state or owner-domain state remains unresolved and is never inferred.
Patrol, approach, pursue, evade and withdraw outcomes update MAL-local behavior/session projections only. They never move canonical Characters/NPCs or mutate World/Scene or Travel truth.
Engage-local and contest-local may reference MAL-04 simple-conflict projections but never initiate or resolve canonical Combat, damage, conditions, wounds, initiative or defeat.
Authorized owner references may gate transitions, but MAL-05 cannot reveal hidden data or commit Action/Event, Project, campaign, progression, reward, reputation or advancement outcomes.
AI may propose behavior/state-machine definitions but cannot invent hidden knowledge, select secret targets, create canonical NPC decisions or commit owner-domain outcomes.
forbidden: copied proprietary game/ROM AI logic, enemy scripts, behavior tables, pathing data or encounter scripts
autonomous canonical NPC/Character agency, goals, personality, knowledge, allegiance or hostility truth
canonical NPC/Character position, Inventory, World/Scene or Travel mutation
canonical Combat initiative, damage, hit-point, condition, wound, defeat or encounter mutation
hidden-data reveal or unauthorized perception/target inference
Action/Event, Project, campaign, progression, reputation, advancement or reward commit

invalidation_events: required validation reports a materially new failure signature

validation_requirement: Exactly one MAL-05 current-family profile, zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine matching self-hosted Linux/Windows acceptance RED before production mutation, then exact-head Linux/Windows GREEN and deterministic comparison.
